documents.title: SUP017 supplier continuity audit
documents.text: Synthetic supplier audit. SUP017 supplies PCB-X41 and primarily uses Yantian port. Severe storms can interrupt its outbound logistics. This audit does not establish a specific delay or maximum monthly capacity.

documents.title: Active emergency inventory transfer policy
documents.text: Synthetic demo policy: emergency inventory transfer may be proposed when the source plant retains its safety stock, the material matches, and the approved route arrives before a shortage. All simulated actions require a human decision. A manager can approve plans costing up to INR 500000; a senior approver is required above that limit.

documents.title: Active alternate sourcing policy
documents.text: Synthetic demo policy: alternate supplier sourcing requires an already approved supplier, compatible material, available capacity and an open route. Human approval cannot override supplier qualification or inventory constraints.

documents.title: Retired sourcing policy
documents.text: Emergency sourcing policy. This obsolete version allowed unqualified suppliers.
